question: At the first eligible immutable snapshot after the commit containing this protocol, does the fixed 25-percent dominant-task pair-share cap pass when newly appearing tasks are handled by explicit baseline-zero extension?
scientific_scope: Decision Corpus structural balance audit only; no predictor effect, accuracy, utility, acquisition-causality, or producer-compliance claim

immutable_baseline.v2_behavior_preserved: task-universe inequality remains a fail-closed condition when allow_task_expansion is false

activation_rule.source_code_requirement: execute from a clean public commit containing this exact protocol and the v3 producer, independent verifier, and tests
activation_rule.snapshot_selection: the earliest immutable successor of 887491a0 in the audited transition chain that was first observed after the source commit and has an exact receipt-only canonical common-support verification

primary_interpretation.condition: all task pair shares are at most 0.25 and exact debt is zero
primary_interpretation.allowed_claim: the selected provisional snapshot satisfies the frozen structural task-balance cap
the selected provisional snapshot does not satisfy the frozen structural task-balance cap

secondary_only: added-task count and explicit zero-extension receipt
forbidden_inputs: prediction pair files, matrices, or values
label, grade, outcome, winner orientation, accuracy, effect, or search utility
kill_conditions: 887491a0 is used as the current v3 snapshot
an earlier eligible successor is skipped
any task is deleted or any pair/run count decreases
the dominant task changes relative to the immutable guard
any snapshot, summary, ledger, common-support, chronology, or source binding fails
